title: I Serve My True Guru, And Meditate
subtitle: Raag Maajh · Ang 136
summary: This shabad opens with i serve my True Guru, and meditate on Him all day and night. It turns the heart toward that day shall bring every joy, O Lord, when I take to the Feet of the Guru.
whyItMatters: It matters when life feels unworthy, guarded, and hard-on-self because the shabad keeps mercy inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private momentum.
takeaway: Keep returning to this turn: That day shall bring every joy, O Lord, when I take to the Feet of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦਿਨ ਰੈਣਿ
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa panjavaa dhin rain
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehla: Day And Night:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਿ ਰੈਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevee satigur aapanaa har simaree dhin sabh rain ||
lines.translation: I serve my True Guru, and meditate on Him all day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਵਾਂ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਮਿਠੜੇ ਵੈਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap tiaag saranee pavaa(n) mukh bolee miThaRe vain ||
lines.translation: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, I seek His Sanctuary, and speak sweet words to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam kaa vichhuRiaa har melahu sajan sain ||
lines.translation: Through countless lifetimes and incarnations, I was separated from Him. O Lord, you are my Friend and Companion-please unite me with Yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੀਅ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਸੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਨ ਵਸਨਿ ਭੈਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jeea har te vichhuRe se sukh na vasan bhain ||
lines.translation: Those who are separated from the Lord do not dwell in peace, O sister.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਚੈਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਖੋਜਿ ਡਿਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਗੈਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: har pir bin chain na paieeaai khoj ddiThe sabh gain ||
lines.translation: Without their Husband Lord, they find no comfort. I have searched and seen all realms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੇਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap kamaanai vichhuRee dhos na kaahoo dhen ||
lines.translation: My own evil actions have kept me separate from Him; why should I accuse anyone else?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੇਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh raakh leh hor naahee karan karen ||
lines.translation: Bestow Your Mercy, God, and save me! No one else can bestow Your Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਖਾਕੂ ਰੂਲਣਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਥੈ ਵੈਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: har tudh vin khaakoo roolanaa kaheeaai kithai vain ||
lines.translation: Without You, Lord, we roll around in the dust. Unto whom should we utter our cries of distress?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਰਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਨੈਣ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa har surajan dhekhaa nain ||1||
lines.translation: This is Nanak's prayer: ""May my eyes behold the Lord, the Angelic Being.""||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeea kee birathaa so sune har sa(n)mrith purakh apaar ||
lines.translation: The Lord hears the anguish of the soul; He is the All-powerful and Infinite Primal Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣਿ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maran jeevan aaraadhanaa sabhanaa kaa aadhaar ||
lines.translation: In death and in life, worship and adore the Lord, the Support of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਵਡਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sasurai peieeaai tis ka(n)t kee vaddaa jis paravaar ||
lines.translation: In this world and in the next, the soul-bride belongs to her Husband Lord, who has such a vast family.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: uoochaa agam agaadh bodh kichh a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
lines.translation: He is Lofty and Inaccessible. His Wisdom is Unfathomable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa saa tis bhaavasee sa(n)taa kee hoi chhaar ||
lines.translation: He has no end or limitation. That service is pleasing to Him, which makes one humble, like the dust of the feet of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦੈਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dheenaa naath dhaiaal dhev patit udhaaranahaar ||
lines.translation: He is the Patron of the poor, the Merciful, Luminous Lord, the Redeemer of sinners.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਖਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aadh jugaadhee rakhadhaa sach naam karataar ||
lines.translation: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the True Name of the Creator has been our Saving Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: keemat koi na jaaniee ko naahee tolanahaar ||
lines.translation: No one can know His Value; no one can weigh it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan a(n)tar vas rahe naanak nahee sumaar ||
lines.translation: He dwells deep within the mind and body. O Nanak, He cannot be measured.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੰਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dhin rain j prabh ka(n)au sevadhe tin kai sadh balihaar ||2||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve God, day and night. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਅਰਾਧਨਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t araadhan sadh sadhaa sabhanaa kaa bakhasi(n)dh ||
lines.translation: The Saints worship and adore Him forever and ever; He is the Forgiver of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਿਤੀਨੁ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeau pi(n)dd jin saajiaa kar kirapaa dhiteen ji(n)dh ||
lines.translation: He fashioned the soul and the body, and by His Kindness, He bestowed the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sabadhee aaraadheeaai japeeaai niramal ma(n)t ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, worship and adore Him, and chant His Pure Mantra.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: keemat kahan na jaieeaai paramesur bea(n)t ||
lines.translation: His Value cannot be evaluated. The Transcendent Lord is endless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਰਾਇਣੋ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis man vasai naraino so kaheeaai bhagava(n)t ||
lines.translation: That one, within whose mind the Lord abides, is said to be most fortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeea kee lochaa pooreeaai milai suaamee ka(n)t ||
lines.translation: The soul's desires are fulfilled, upon meeting the Master, our Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ ਦੋਖ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਹੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jeevai jap haree dhokh sabhe hee ha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Nanak lives by chanting the Lord's Name; all sorrows have been erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੰਤੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dhin rain jis na visarai so hariaa hovai ja(n)t ||3||
lines.translation: One who does not forget Him, day and night, is continually rejuvenated. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਣੋ ਮੰਞੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa prabh poorano ma(n)n(j) nimaanee thaau ||
lines.translation: God is overflowing with all powers. I have no honor-He is my resting place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har oT gahee man a(n)dhare jap jap jeevaa(n) naau ||
lines.translation: I have grasped the Support of the Lord within my mind; I live by chanting and meditating on His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਨ ਧੂੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee jan dhooRee sa(n)g samaau ||
lines.translation: Grant Your Grace, God, and bless me, that I may merge into the dust of the feet of the humble.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨਾ ਖਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiau too(n) raakheh tiau rahaa teraa dhitaa painaa khaau ||
lines.translation: As You keep me, so do I live. I wear and eat whatever You give me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: audham soiee karai prabh mil saadhoo gun gaau ||
lines.translation: May I make the effort, O God, to sing Your Glorious Praises in the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਕੂਕਣ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhoojee jai na sujhiee kithai kookan jaau ||
lines.translation: I can conceive of no other place; where could I go to lodge a complaint?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਤਮ ਹਰਣ ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਮਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: agiaan binaasan tam haran uooche agam amaau ||
lines.translation: You are the Dispeller of ignorance, the Destroyer of darkness, O Lofty, Unfathomable and Unapproachable Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man vichhuRiaa har meleeaai naanak eh suaau ||
lines.translation: Please unite this separated one with Yourself; this is Nanak's yearning.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sarab kaliaanaa tit dhin har parasee gur ke paau ||4||1||
lines.translation: That day shall bring every joy, O Lord, when I take to the Feet of the Guru. ||4||1||

structure: It opens by naming the condition without ornament: i serve my True Guru, and meditate on Him all day and night.
The middle movement widens the correction through he dwells deep within the mind and body. O Nanak, He cannot be measured.
It closes with a return you can actually keep: that day shall bring every joy, O Lord, when I take to the Feet of the Guru.
